text: Can gain a product's tools instantly by being given its URL, without waiting for a native integration to be built
quote: you can hand Lindy the URL and it gains that product's tools without waiting for a native integration

text: Uses stored credentials to run shell commands and execute code
quote: Credentials are what Lindy reaches for when it runs shell commands and code.

text: Can control a browser like a human or write its own integration against a tool's API when no integration exists
quote: It can drive the browser the way a person would, or write its own integration against the tool's API.

text: Lets you pick which AI model to use for each task, with most major models available
quote: Pick your model of choice for each task. Most major models are available.

text: Learns a process once, saves it as a reusable skill, and automatically invokes it whenever a matching request comes in
quote: Describe the process once, and from then on Lindy picks the right skill whenever a request calls for it. You never have to remember to invoke one.

text: Set a schedule or trigger once and Lindy runs the recurring job automatically going forward
quote: Lindy routines turn your recurring work into hands-off automation — set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot

text: Guardrails let you configure what actions Lindy can take autonomously versus needing confirmation
quote: Guardrails decide what Lindy can do without asking.

text: Supports Slack slash commands to check diagnostics, connection status, and account settings via natural language
quote: Show your Slack diagnostics for the last 7 days.

text: Combines your emails, meetings, and calendar context with live web research to answer questions
quote: Lindy combines your work context (emails, meetings, calendar) with deep web research to give you thorough, relevant answers.

text: Acts as a built-in assistant that triages your inbox with labels, sends a morning brief, and drafts email responses
quote: Your inbox is triaged with color-coded labels, a morning brief tells you what happened overnight, and every email that needs a response has a draft waiting.

text: Quickly connects to your Slack, email, calendar, and phone to start working within minutes
quote: Get Lindy into your team's Slack, then connect your own email, calendar, and phone. Two minutes.

text: Can point at a hosted MCP server and automatically build actions from the tools that server exposes
quote: Point Lindy at a hosted MCP server and it builds actions from the tools that server publishes.

text: Can chain actions across connected apps based on an event, e.g. tracing a GitHub change, updating Salesforce, and drafting a Gmail summary
quote: traces the change that caused them in GitHub, enriches the contact record in Salesforce, drafts the summary in Gmail

text: Lets you save a credential/key privately for yourself, then optionally share it with the whole workspace
quote: Save a key and only you can use it, until you choose to share it with everyone in the workspace.

text: Is SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and PIPEDA compliant, with data encrypted and never used to train models
quote: Lindy is AICPA SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and PIPEDA compliant. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, never sold, and never used to train models.
